La caída desde un muelle de carga puede: A fall from a loading dock can exceed 1.2 metres. Retractable guardrails allow passage when a vehicle is present. Check the condition of the protections monthly
Inspección de protecciones de muelle: me: Inspection of dock protections: monthly. Repair or replacement: immediate if deficiencies are detected (NTP 1076 INSST)
Debe realizarse evaluación de riesgos pa: A risk assessment must be carried out for all manual handling of loads over 3 kg that may involve a musculoskeletal risk, using the INSHT method or equivalent
¿Se ha realizado evaluación de riesgos d: Has an MMC (manual handling of loads) risk assessment been carried out for all jobs involving lifting, carrying or holding loads >3 kg? Have operations involving lithium batteries or other heavy loads been identified?
Evaluación de riesgos de MMC por puesto: MMC risk assessment by job (INSHT method) + identification of at-risk tasks + corrective action plan with deadlines
Recommended method: INSHT technical guide. NIOSH 91 and the Snook and Ciriello tables are also valid. Apply especially to the movement of lithium batteries. Reference limit: 25 kg under ideal conditions
•\tEvaluación de riesgos (se recomienda:
•	Risk assessment (the INSHT one is recommended)
•	Health surveillance reports with the formulation and design of a specific medical protocol
•	Record of the training/information received by the worker
Evaluación inicial: antes de inicio de a: Initial assessment: before the activity starts. Review: annual or whenever loads, tasks, frequencies or exposed workers change (RD 487/1997)
Los trabajadores que realizan MMC deben: Workers who carry out MMC must receive specific training and information on musculoskeletal risks and correct handling techniques
¿Los trabajadores que realizan MMC han r: Have workers who carry out MMC received specific training on correct lifting, carrying and posture techniques? Is there a signed record of this training with date and content?
Registros de formación en MMC firmados p: MMC training records signed by the workers + training programme with specific content
La formación debe incluir: factores de r: Training must include: risk factors (weight, posture, frequency, distance), health consequences and correct techniques. Include the use of mechanical handling aids
Formación inicial: al incorporarse al pu: Initial training: on joining the job. Refresher: annual or when tasks or workers change (RD 487/1997 Art. 4)
Los trabajadores expuestos a riesgos de: Workers exposed to MMC risks must receive specific health surveillance with a medical protocol for musculoskeletal disorders of the spine
¿Se realiza vigilancia de la salud espec: Is specific health surveillance carried out for workers exposed to MMC, with a medical protocol that includes medical history, spinal examination and relevant occupational history?
Informes de vigilancia de la salud (anon: Health surveillance reports (anonymised) + specific spinal medical protocol + records of periodic medical examinations
La vigilancia de la salud debe ser espec: Health surveillance must be specific, not generic. The medical protocol must record occupational exposure, history and spinal examination. Individual reports are confidential
Reconocimiento médico específico de MMC:: Specific MMC medical examination: on joining + periodic (annual for high exposure) + on return to work after sick leave for a musculoskeletal disorder (RD 487/1997 Art. 5)
Las carretillas y transpaletas utilizada: Forklifts and pallet trucks used for load handling must comply with the minimum requirements for mobile and lifting work equipment set out in RD 1215/1997
¿Las carretillas y transpaletas disponen: Do the forklifts and pallet trucks have CE marking, a declaration of conformity and an instruction manual? Have their risks been assessed in accordance with Annexes I and II of RD 1215/1997?
Marcado CE + declaración de conformidad: CE marking + declaration of conformity + instruction manual for forklifts and pallet trucks + risk assessment referencing Annexes I and II of RD 1215/1997
Incluir transpaletas manuales y eléctric: Include manual and electric pallet trucks, counterbalance and reach trucks. Equipment dating from before 1995 must have a certificate of conformity upgrade to RD 1215/1997
Verificación de documentación CE: al adq: Verification of CE documentation: on acquiring the equipment. Risk assessment: initial and annual review. Maintenance: according to the manufacturer's plan (RD 1215/1997)
El mantenimiento de carretillas y transp: Maintenance of forklifts and pallet trucks must be documented, with records kept throughout the service life of the equipment
¿Existe un plan de mantenimiento prevent: Is there a preventive maintenance plan for forklifts and pallet trucks with intervals defined according to the manufacturer? Are the maintenance records up to date and available?
Plan de mantenimiento por equipo + regis: Maintenance plan per item of equipment + dated and signed intervention records + incident log per item of equipment
Los registros de mantenimiento deben con: Maintenance records must be kept throughout the service life of the equipment. Include: checks of brakes, steering, hydraulics, electrical/LPG system and forks
Mantenimiento preventivo: según plan del: Preventive maintenance: according to the manufacturer's plan (typically quarterly for high-intensity forklifts). Records: keep throughout the service life of the equipment (RD 1215/1997 Art. 4)
Para cargas que superen los límites reco: For loads exceeding the recommended MMC limits, mechanical handling aids must be provided (pallet trucks, trolleys, hoists, assisted lifting systems)
¿Se dispone de medios mecánicos de ayuda: Are mechanical handling aids available and accessible to workers when loads exceed the recommended limits? Are workers trained in the correct use of these aids?
Inventario de medios mecánicos de ayuda: Inventory of available mechanical handling aids + location in the workplace + training in the use of mechanical aids
La eliminación o reducción de la MMC man: Eliminating or reducing manual handling is the priority preventive measure. Consider investing in assisted handling systems, especially for lithium batteries and loads >25 kg
Revisión de disponibilidad de medios mec: Review of the availability of mechanical aids: annual or when loads or workstations change (RD 487/1997 + RD 1215/1997)
Los equipos de trabajo deben disponer de: Work equipment must have guards and protective devices that prevent access to dangerous moving parts and prevent operators from becoming trapped
¿Todos los equipos de trabajo con partes: Do all items of work equipment with dangerous moving parts (winding machines, conveyor belts, folding machines) have guards fitted and in good condition? Is their condition checked before each shift?
Registros de inspección de guardas antes: Guard inspection records before each shift + risk assessment of moving parts + photographs of the protection systems installed
Las guardas no deben poder retirarse sin: Guards must not be removable without a tool. Never allow machinery to be operated without guards fitted. Maintenance personnel must apply LOTO before removing any guard

El personal que realiza el mantenimiento: The personnel who carry out maintenance on equipment such as the winding machines or the gates are external, so it would not be Amara's responsibility to apply a LOTO system. Amara personnel may neither modify nor carry out maintenance on the equipment they operate. This is not our activity.
La exigencia de cómo tienen que trabajar:
Setting out how contractors must work is the responsibility of the principal employer.
In any case, the machine in its current state appears dangerous to us, and it would be advisable to generate all the necessary documentation
Inspección de guardas: antes de cada tur: Guard inspection: before each shift (operator) + formal monthly inspection (supervisor). Review of the moving-parts risk assessment: annual (RD 1215/1997 Annex I)
Las máquinas deben disponer de dispositi: Machines must have emergency stop devices (emergency stop button) in an accessible position, clearly identified and functionally checked on a regular basis
¿Todos los equipos de trabajo disponen d: Do all items of work equipment have an emergency stop accessible from the operator's position? Is the operation of the emergency stop buttons checked periodically and recorded?
Registros de verificación funcional de p: Functional check records for emergency stops + photographic identification of the buttons on each item of equipment
Las setas de emergencia deben ser de cab: Emergency stop buttons must have a red mushroom head on a yellow background and be of the self-latching type. Never use the emergency stop as a routine operating control. Check that its activation isolates all hazardous energy sources
Verificación funcional de paradas de eme: Functional check of emergency stops: monthly. Visual inspection: before each shift. Records: keep for a minimum of 1 year (RD 1215/1997 Annex I)
Debe aplicarse un procedimiento de bloqu: A lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure for hazardous energy must be applied in all maintenance work to prevent the unintended start-up of machinery
¿Existe un procedimiento LOTO documentad: Is there a documented LOTO procedure known to maintenance personnel? Are sufficient padlocks, locking devices and tags available for all equipment?
Procedimiento LOTO escrito + inventario: Written LOTO procedure + inventory of locking devices per item of equipment + LOTO training records for maintenance personnel
Cada trabajador que opera en equipos ais: Each worker operating on isolated equipment must have their own personal padlock. Never remove another worker's padlock. Verify the zero-energy state before starting work
Procedimiento LOTO: revisión anual + tra: LOTO procedure: annual review + after any related incident. LOTO training: initial for all maintenance personnel + annual refresher (RD 1215/1997 + RD 614/2001)
Las puertas automáticas de carga deben t: Automatic loading gates must have certified anti-entrapment safety devices that stop or reverse the movement on contact with a person
¿Las puertas automáticas disponen de can: Do the automatic doors have safety edges and/or photoelectric cells that stop the closing movement on contact with a person or obstacle? Is their operation checked at each maintenance visit?
Certificado de los dispositivos de segur: Certificate for the safety devices + result of the functional check at each maintenance visit + six-monthly maintenance records
Las células fotoeléctricas deben cubrir: Photoelectric cells must cover the full height of the opening. Safety edges must be on the bottom edge of sectional doors. Check that the reversal is effective
Verificación funcional de dispositivos a: Functional check of anti-entrapment devices: at each six-monthly maintenance visit. Visual inspection: monthly (RD 486/1997 Annex 1-A point 6)
Los equipos de trabajo deben someterse a: Work equipment must undergo periodic checks of the anti-entrapment safety systems, with the results documented
¿Se incluyen en el plan de mantenimiento: Does the maintenance plan include specific checks of the condition and operation of the anti-entrapment systems (guards, interlocks, emergency stops)?
Plan de mantenimiento con sección especí: Maintenance plan with a specific section on anti-entrapment safety systems + inspection records
El plan de mantenimiento debe distinguir: The maintenance plan must distinguish between operational maintenance and verification of safety systems. Do not combine the two in the same record. Safety systems are checked with the equipment in safe mode
Comprobación de sistemas de seguridad: e: Check of safety systems: at each preventive maintenance visit. Records: keep throughout the service life of the equipment (RD 1215/1997 Art. 4)
Las vías de circulación situadas bajo zo: Traffic routes located beneath high-level storage areas must be protected or marked to prevent the risk of objects falling on workers
¿Las vías de paso bajo zonas de almacena: Are walkways beneath high-level storage areas protected with anti-fall mesh or netting, or marked with access restrictions during stacking operations?
Fotografías de vías protegidas bajo zona: Photographs of protected routes beneath high-level storage areas + procedure restricting passage during stacking + falling-object risk assessment
Si no es posible la protección física, e: If physical protection is not possible, establish a system prohibiting passage during high-level stacking manoeuvres. Consider protective netting in high-bay warehouses

El responsable de almacén debe realizar: The warehouse manager must carry out a monthly inspection covering equipment such as racking, pallets, etc. Amara personnel are prohibited from making any modification to the racking. An annual inspection is carried out by an expert engineer and, depending on their findings, another external company carries out the repairs. When any part of the racking is struck, an external company is notified to repair it.
Es buena práctica esa revisión mensual,: The monthly inspection is good practice, but that does not remove the need to have all the documentation indicated
Inspección de protecciones: mensual. Rev: Inspection of protections: monthly. Review of the passage procedure: annual or after any falling-object incident (RD 486/1997 Annex 1-A point 5)
Las estanterías deben estar correctament: Racking must be correctly anchored, with the maximum load marked per level and bay, and inspected monthly to detect damage that could cause collapse
¿Las estanterías están ancladas al suelo: Is the racking anchored to the floor and/or wall? Does it have visible maximum-load signs per level and bay? Is a monthly inspection carried out with a record of findings?
Documentación del instalador de estanter: Racking installer's documentation + maximum-load signage + monthly inspection records + procedure for taking damaged bays out of service
Los pilares de las estanterías expuestos: Racking uprights exposed to forklift traffic must have protectors. Never exceed the indicated maximum load. Horizontal bracing members are not decorative: they are structural
Inspección mensual: por operarios o resp: Monthly inspection: by operators or the warehouse manager. Annual technical inspection: by a person competent in racking. Repair: immediate in the event of damage (NTP 852 INSST)
Los daños en estanterías detectados dura: Damage to racking detected during operations must be reported immediately and the affected bay taken out of service until it has been technically repaired
¿Existe un sistema de notificación de da: Is there a racking damage reporting system accessible to forklift operators? Are damaged bays marked and taken out of service immediately?
Sistema de notificación de daños en esta: Racking damage reporting system (tags, QR codes, etc.) + records of reported damage + corrective actions taken, with dates
La cultura de reporte de daños en estant: A culture of reporting racking damage is key. A bent racking upright can collapse under load without warning. Never straighten damaged steel sections without a technical assessment
Reporte de daños: inmediato. Retirada de: Damage reporting: immediate. Taking the damaged bay out of service: immediate. Technical repair: as soon as possible. Records: keep the history of damage and repairs (NTP 852 INSST)
Los equipos de elevación deben disponer: Lifting equipment must have devices that prevent the load from falling in the event of a hoisting system failure (safety brakes, safety latches on hooks)
¿Los equipos de elevación (puente grúa,: Does the lifting equipment (overhead crane, hoists) have a safety brake that engages automatically in the event of a power failure? Do the hooks have safety latches in good condition?
Certificación de frenos de seguridad de: Certification of safety brakes on lifting equipment + check of safety latches on hooks + inspection records
Los pestillos de seguridad de los gancho: Hook safety latches must be checked before each use. Safety brakes must be tested at each periodic inspection. Never use hooks with a defective latch
Inspección de pestillos antes de cada us: Latch inspection before each use. Check of safety brakes: at each periodic inspection of the equipment. OCA (authorised inspection body) inspection: at least annual for lifting equipment (RD 1215/1997)
Los accesorios de izado (eslingas, grill: Lifting accessories (slings, shackles, load chains) must be inspected before each use, have their WLL visible and be within their service life
¿Todos los accesorios de izado tienen la: Do all lifting accessories have the working load limit (CMT/WLL) visibly marked? Are they inspected before each use and withdrawn if they show damage or exceed their service life?
Inventario de accesorios de izado con CM: Inventory of lifting accessories with WLL + pre-use inspection procedure + record of defective accessories withdrawn
Las eslingas textiles deben retirarse si: Textile slings must be withdrawn if they show cuts, fraying or acid/alkali stains. Chains: if they have deformed, elongated or cracked links. Shackles: if the pin is bent or the bow is deformed
Inspección de accesorios de izado: antes: Inspection of lifting accessories: before each use (visual). Periodic formal inspection: six-monthly. Withdrawal: immediate if damage is detected. Replacement: according to the manufacturer's service life (RD 1215/1997 Annex I)
Los materiales almacenados en estantería: Materials stored on racking must be placed stably, without protruding beyond the racking limits and without exceeding the maximum load indicated per level
¿Existe un procedimiento de almacenamien: Is there a storage procedure setting out the correct placement of materials (centred on the pallet, not protruding, within load limits)? Are workers trained in this procedure?
Procedimiento de almacenamiento correcto: Correct storage procedure + records of operator training in the procedure + photographs of storage areas
Las cargas inestables o mal paletizadas: Unstable or poorly palletised loads are the leading cause of falling objects in warehouses. Establish rejection criteria for damaged pallets before storing them at height
Verificación de almacenamiento correcto:: Verification of correct storage: daily (operators) + formal weekly check with a record. Review of the procedure: annual (NTP 298 INSST)
Debe realizarse una evaluación de riesgo: An explosive atmospheres risk assessment must be carried out, considering the likelihood of formation, ignition sources and the installations present (especially in Pb battery charging areas)
¿Se ha realizado una evaluación de riesg: Has an ATEX risk assessment been carried out for the Pb battery charging areas and other areas at risk of an explosive atmosphere? Was NTP 876 or another recognised methodology used?
Evaluación de riesgos ATEX + metodología: ATEX risk assessment + methodology used (NTP 876 or equivalent) + date of last review
Las estaciones de carga de baterías de P: Pb battery charging stations generate hydrogen during charging, creating a potential ATEX Zone 2. A qualitative "what if?" type assessment may be sufficient for low-risk installations
•\tEvaluación de riesgo para atmósferas:
•	Risk assessment for explosive atmospheres
•	Zone classification
•	Explosion protection document (DPCE).
•	Staff training record
•	Certificate for antistatic clothing and footwear
•	ATEX Cat 1, 2 or 3 certificate for all equipment that could generate a spark.
•	Filing, for a period of time, of the work permits issued in that zone, signed by the preventive resource.
•	Appropriate signage
Se dispone de DCPE, se va a realizar su: A DPCE (explosion protection document) is in place; its third revision is going to be carried out following the changes to the battery charging areas.
Evaluación ATEX: inicial antes del inici: ATEX assessment: initial, before the activity starts. Review: whenever the substances, processes, equipment or ventilation of the affected areas change (RD 681/2003 Art. 6)
Las zonas con riesgo de atmósferas explo: Areas at risk of explosive atmospheres must be classified into categories (Zone 0/1/2 for gases; 20/21/22 for dusts) according to the likelihood of formation and the duration of the explosive atmosphere
¿Se han clasificado todas las zonas ATEX: Have all ATEX zones of the installation been classified in the correct category? Is there an up-to-date hazardous area classification drawing prepared by a competent technician?
Plano de clasificación de zonas ATEX (Zo: ATEX zone classification drawing (Zone 0/1/2) + technical justification for the classification + name of the competent technician who carried out the classification
Las estaciones de carga de baterías de P: Pb battery charging stations generate a Zone 2 in their immediate surroundings. The classification must be carried out by a competent ATEX technician. The drawing must be available at the workplace
Clasificación de zonas: permanente. Revi: Zone classification: permanent. Review: whenever the processes, substances, ventilation or layout of the classified areas change (RD 681/2003 Art. 7)
Debe elaborarse y mantenerse actualizado: The Explosion Protection Document (DPCE) must be drawn up and kept up to date, using INSST NTP 826 as a reference
¿Se ha elaborado el DPCE para todas las: Has the DPCE been drawn up for all classified ATEX zones? Does it include the risk assessment, zone classification, permitted equipment and safe working procedures?
Documento de Protección contra Explosion: Explosion Protection Document (DPCE) + ATEX zone drawing incorporated into the DPCE + date of last update
El DPCE debe elaborarse antes del inicio: The DPCE must be drawn up before work begins in classified zones. Consult INSST NTP 826 as a content guide. Update whenever conditions or equipment change
DPCE: elaborar antes del inicio de la ac: DPCE: draw up before the activity starts in ATEX zones. Update: whenever zones, equipment or processes change. Recommended review: annual (RD 681/2003 Art. 8)
Todo trabajador que acceda a zonas ATEX: Every worker entering ATEX zones must receive specific training on explosion risks, safe working procedures and the applicable work permits before entry
¿Los trabajadores que acceden a zonas AT: Have workers entering ATEX zones received specific training? Is there a list of workers authorised to enter each classified zone?
Registros de formación ATEX firmados con: Signed ATEX training records with date and content + list of authorised workers per zone + trainer's accreditation
Incluir a los contratistas que accedan o: Include contractors who enter occasionally. Training must cover: nature of the risk, prohibited equipment, work permits, emergency response and use of antistatic PPE
Formación inicial: antes del primer acce: Initial training: before first entry into an ATEX zone. Refresher: every 2 years or when zones or procedures change. Records: permanent (RD 681/2003 Art. 9)
Los trabajadores en zonas ATEX deben dis: Workers in ATEX zones must be provided with antistatic footwear and work clothing that does not generate electrostatic discharges capable of igniting explosive atmospheres
¿Los trabajadores que acceden a zonas AT: Are workers entering ATEX zones provided with certified antistatic footwear (resistance <100 MΩ) and antistatic clothing? Are the certificates for this PPE kept?
Certificados de calzado antiestático (EN: Certificates for antistatic footwear (EN ISO 20345 + resistance <100 MΩ) + certificates for antistatic clothing (EN 1149) + individual issue records
Verificar que los EPIs no han superado s: Check that PPE has not exceeded its service life. Antistatic footwear loses its properties with use. Antistatic clothing must not be washed with fabric softener (it destroys the antistatic properties)
Entrega de EPIs antiestáticos: antes del: Issue of antistatic PPE: before first entry into an ATEX zone. Condition check: before each use. Replacement: according to the manufacturer's service life (RD 681/2003 + RD 773/1997)
Los trabajos en zonas ATEX deben realiza: Work in ATEX zones must be carried out under a work permit system, with permits issued by an authorised person and a preventive resource present throughout the activity
¿Existe un sistema de permisos de trabaj: Is there a work permit system for activities in ATEX zones? Are permits issued by an expressly authorised person? Does the preventive resource remain present during the work?
Modelo de permiso de trabajo en zona ATE: ATEX zone work permit template + records of permits issued (filed) + designation of the preventive resource, with signature on the permits
El recurso preventivo debe tener formaci: The preventive resource must have, as a minimum, basic-level PRL (occupational risk prevention) training (50 hours). Permits must be filed. Continuous supervision is mandatory in ATEX zones during work with an ignition risk
Permiso de trabajo: emitido para cada ac: Work permit: issued for each activity in an ATEX zone. Permit archive: keep for a minimum of 1 year. Preventive resource: designate and record their presence at each job (RD 681/2003 Art. 9)
Todos los equipos utilizados en zonas AT: All equipment used in ATEX zones must have ATEX certification of the appropriate category (Cat. 1, 2 or 3 depending on the zone) and visible Ex marking
¿Existe un inventario de todos los equip: Is there an inventory of all equipment in ATEX zones with its certification category and certificate number? Is the Ex marking visible on all equipment?
Inventario de equipos ATEX con categoría: Inventory of ATEX equipment with category and certificate number + photographs of the Ex marking on equipment + verification that the category is appropriate for the zone
For Zone 2: equipment up to Category 3. For Zone 1: minimum Category 2. For Zone 0: Category 1. Include: light fittings, electrical panels, power tools, vehicles and mobile phones
Verificación inicial: antes de instalar: Initial verification: before installing any equipment in an ATEX zone. Inventory review: annual + whenever new equipment is installed in a classified zone (RD 681/2003 + RD 144/2016)
Los accesos a zonas ATEX deben señalizar: Entrances to ATEX zones must be marked with the standardised explosive atmosphere pictogram (EX triangle) in accordance with Directive 1999/92/CE
¿Los accesos a las zonas ATEX clasificad: Are the entrances to classified ATEX zones marked with the standardised EX pictogram (yellow triangle with a flame and the letters EX in black)? Is the signage in good condition and visible?
Fotografías de señalización ATEX en todo: Photographs of ATEX signage at all entrances to classified zones + inspection of the condition of the signs
Colocar en todos los accesos a zonas cla: Place at all entrances to classified zones, regardless of the level of use. Check condition and visibility monthly. Update if the zone boundaries change
Instalación de señalización: antes de la: Installation of signage: before the first activity in an ATEX zone. Condition inspection: monthly. Update: when the boundaries of classified zones change (RD 485/1997)
Todo trabajo en altura (>2 metros) debe: All work at height (>2 metres) must be assessed and protected with collective protection measures (guardrails, nets) as the first option before resorting to fall-arrest PPE
¿Se han identificado todos los trabajos: Have all work-at-height activities at the site been identified, and has it been verified that collective protection measures are the first option applied? Is fall-arrest PPE used only when collective protection is not possible?
Evaluación de riesgos de trabajos en alt: Risk assessment of work at height with hierarchy of controls + inventory of work-at-height points + documentation of the collective protections installed
Jerarquía obligatoria: 1) eliminar el tr: Mandatory hierarchy: 1) eliminate the work at height, 2) collective protection (guardrails minimum 90 cm), 3) fall-arrest PPE. Never reverse this order without documented technical justification

En Meco los trabajadores que usan la rec: In Meco, the workers who use the order picker hold the authorisation and training for its use. It has CE marking and an instruction manual. Portable ladders are inspected internally using a checklist, and there is a work instruction for portable ladders.
Evaluación de trabajos en altura: inicia: Assessment of work at height: initial + annual review or when the work or installations change. Inspection of collective protections: monthly (RD 2177/2004 + RD 1215/1997)
Cuando el trabajo en altura requiere EPI: When work at height requires fall-arrest PPE, anchor points must be certified for a minimum load of 12 kN per worker and harnesses must be inspected before each use
¿Los puntos de anclaje para trabajos en: Do the anchor points for work at height have load certification (minimum 12 kN)? Are harnesses and fall-arrest equipment inspected before each use and withdrawn if they show damage?
Certificados de carga de puntos de ancla: Load certificates for anchor points + pre-use harness inspection procedure + records of defective equipment withdrawn
Los arneses deben retirarse si han sufri: Harnesses must be withdrawn if they have arrested a fall, even if they show no visible damage. Service life is 10 years from manufacture or as specified by the manufacturer. Automatic connectors must be checked at each use
Inspección de arneses: antes de cada uso: Harness inspection: before each use (visual). Formal inspection: six-monthly by a competent person. Anchors: initial certification + annual review. Replacement: according to service life (RD 2177/2004)
Las plataformas de trabajo elevadoras mó: Mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs) must have CE marking, a declaration of conformity and an instruction manual, and must undergo documented periodic inspections
¿Las plataformas elevadoras móviles tien: Do the mobile elevating work platforms have CE marking, a declaration of conformity and an instruction manual available? Has their use been assessed in accordance with Annexes I and II of RD 1215/1997?
Marcado CE + declaración de conformidad: CE marking + declaration of conformity + MEWP instruction manual + risk assessment referencing Annexes I and II of RD 1215/1997
Incluir tijeras (plataformas verticales): Include scissor lifts (vertical platforms) and articulated booms. Check that the floor can bear the weight of the platform at maximum load. Never exceed the maximum basket load
Verificación de documentación CE: al adq: Verification of CE documentation: on acquiring the equipment. Maintenance: according to the manufacturer. Periodic OCA (authorised inspection body) inspection: according to use and risk. Records: keep throughout the service life (RD 1215/1997 Annex I)
Los operadores de plataformas elevadoras: Operators of mobile elevating work platforms must hold certified specific training for each type of equipment and internal authorisation for each type of platform
¿Los operadores de PEMP disponen de form: Do MEWP operators hold certified specific training for each type of platform? Is there a list of authorised operators by type of equipment?
Certificados de formación de operadores: MEWP operator training certificates by type of equipment + list of authorised operators by type of platform + training records
La formación para tijera no equivale a f: Training for scissor lifts is not equivalent to training for articulated booms. Keep separate lists by type. Suspend authorisation if improper use is observed
Formación de operadores de PEMP: inicial: MEWP operator training: initial, before first use. Refresher: every 2-3 years or when a new type of platform is introduced. Internal authorisation: annual review (RD 1215/1997 Art. 5)
Las plataformas elevadoras móviles deben: Mobile elevating work platforms must undergo documented preventive maintenance and periodic inspections, with records kept throughout the service life of the equipment
¿Existe un plan de mantenimiento prevent: Is there a preventive maintenance plan for each MEWP with intervals according to the manufacturer? Are the maintenance and inspection records up to date?
Plan de mantenimiento por PEMP + registr: Maintenance plan per MEWP + dated and signed intervention records + incident log
Incluir en el mantenimiento: sistemas de: Include in maintenance: lifting systems, brakes, emergency lowering systems, tilt alarms and ROPS/FOPS protective structures where applicable
Mantenimiento preventivo: según fabrican: Preventive maintenance: according to the manufacturer (typically six-monthly for MEWPs). Records: keep throughout the service life of the equipment (RD 1215/1997 Art. 4)
La formación para trabajos en altura (us: Training for work at height (use of harnesses, lifelines, portable ladders) must be documented and specific to the tasks and equipment used at the site
¿Los trabajadores que realizan tareas en: Have workers who carry out tasks at height received specific training in the use of harnesses, anchor points and fall-arrest equipment? Are the training records available?
Registros de formación en trabajos en al: Signed work-at-height training records + training programme with specific content + trainer's accreditation
La formación debe incluir: inspección pr: Training must include: pre-use inspection of PPE, work-at-height techniques, basic suspension rescue and safe use of portable ladders
Formación inicial: antes del primer trab: Initial training: before first work at height. Refresher: annual or when procedures or equipment change. Records: permanent (RD 2177/2004)
La conducción de carretillas y transpale: Driving self-propelled forklifts and pallet trucks is reserved exclusively for workers with certified specific training in the safe operation of each type of equipment
¿Todos los conductores de carretillas y: Do all drivers of self-propelled forklifts and pallet trucks hold certified specific training for each type of equipment they drive? Is there internal authorisation by vehicle type and driver?
Certificados de formación de conducción: Driving training certificates by type of equipment and worker + list of authorised drivers by type of equipment + internal authorisation procedure
La autorización interna es una designaci: Internal authorisation is an express designation by the employer, separate from the training licence or certificate. Check that the training is specific to the type of equipment (counterbalance ≠ reach truck ≠ pallet truck)
•\tEvaluación de riesgo teniendo en cuen:
•	Risk assessment taking into account the requirements of the Royal Decree, Annexes 1 and 2, for the forklifts and pallet trucks. Also taking into account: traffic routes in Annex 1-A point 5 of RD 486/1997 
•	CE marking of this equipment and upgrades to RD 1215 where necessary.
•	Instruction manual for this equipment.
•	Maintenance and inspection plan for the equipment. 
•	Records of that maintenance and those inspections
•	Training and information prepared for the operators of this equipment.
•	Record of this training/information.
•	Training for drivers of self-propelled equipment
•	Record of this training
Formación de conductores: inicial + reci: Driver training: initial + refresher every 2-3 years. Internal authorisation: annual review + immediate review if new equipment or a new driver is introduced (RD 1215/1997 Art. 5.2)
Las carretillas y transpaletas deben som: Forklifts and pallet trucks must undergo a daily pre-use check using a checklist, and documented periodic preventive maintenance
¿Los conductores realizan una inspección: Do drivers carry out a pre-use inspection using a checklist before each shift? Is defective equipment taken out of service until repaired?
Listas de comprobación previa al uso com: Pre-use checklists completed per shift + records of defects detected and repairs + procedure for taking equipment out of service
La lista de comprobación debe cubrir: fr: The checklist must cover: brakes, steering, lights, horn, forks, tyre condition, battery/fuel level and operation of the seat and seat belt
Inspección previa al uso: antes de cada: Pre-use inspection: before each shift. Preventive maintenance: according to the manufacturer (typically quarterly for high-intensity use). Records: keep throughout the service life (RD 1215/1997 Art. 4)
Las vías de circulación de vehículos ind: Traffic routes for industrial vehicles must be appropriately sized, marked with floor markings and separated from pedestrian routes either physically or by signage
¿Las vías de circulación de carretillas: Are forklift traffic routes clearly marked on the floor? Is there physical or marked separation between vehicle and pedestrian routes? Are pedestrian walkways wide enough?
Plano de circulación del almacén con vía: Warehouse traffic plan with differentiated vehicle and pedestrian routes + photographs of floor markings + vehicle–pedestrian collision risk assessment
Anchura mínima de vías de carretilla: an: Minimum forklift route width: vehicle width + 0.40 m on each side (two-way traffic: twice the width + 1 m). Physical separation (barriers, walls) is always preferable to signage
Inspección de señalización y demarcación: Inspection of signage and floor markings: monthly. Review of the traffic plan: whenever the layout or vehicle fleet changes (RD 486/1997 Annex 1-A point 5)
Los cruces entre vías de vehículos y zon: Crossings between vehicle routes and pedestrian areas must be marked with pedestrian crossings, convex mirrors at blind corners and speed limit signs
¿Los cruces entre rutas de carretillas y: Are crossings between forklift routes and pedestrian areas marked with floor-painted pedestrian crossings, convex mirrors at blind corners and maximum speed signs?
Fotografías de intersecciones con señali: Photographs of intersections with signage + inventory of convex mirrors and speed signs + assessment of blind spots in the warehouse
Los ángulos ciegos son la principal caus: Blind spots are the main cause of collisions in warehouses. Install convex mirrors at all crossings and blind corners. In high-traffic warehouses, consider traffic lights or automatic barriers
Inspección de señalización en cruces: me: Inspection of signage at crossings: monthly. Review of the mirror inventory: annual or when the layout changes (RD 486/1997 Annex 1-A point 5)
La señalización de tráfico interno del a: Internal warehouse traffic signage (speed limits, directions of travel, right of way, pedestrian crossing areas) must comply with RD 485/1997 and be kept in good condition
¿La señalización de tráfico interno cump: Does the internal traffic signage comply with RD 485/1997 (standardised signs)? Is it clearly visible and in good condition? Are the signs updated when the layout or routes change?
Inventario de señalización de tráfico in: Inventory of internal traffic signage + photographs of current condition + record of signage updates
Utilizar señalización normalizada confor: Use standardised signage in accordance with RD 485/1997. The recommended maximum speed in warehouses is 10 km/h in general and 5 km/h in areas with a high pedestrian presence
Inspección de señalización: mensual. Act: Signage inspection: monthly. Update: immediate when routes or layout change or new risk points are identified (RD 485/1997)
Las vías y salidas de evacuación deben e: Evacuation routes and exits must be marked with photoluminescent signage, kept free of obstructions and lit by permanent emergency lighting
¿Las vías de evacuación están señalizada: Are evacuation routes marked with photoluminescent signage in good condition? Do emergency doors open outwards without a key and are they free of stored goods? Does the emergency lighting work correctly?
Plano de evacuación + inspección mensual: Evacuation plan + monthly inspection of routes and signage + emergency lighting test records
Las salidas de emergencia nunca deben bl: Emergency exits must never be blocked with goods. Check monthly that doors open correctly from the inside. Emergency lighting must be tested monthly (30 sec) and annually (full duration)
o\tMarcado CE o equivalente para todos l:
o	CE marking or equivalent for all equipment
o	Design or technical documentation for the installation
o	Installer's certificate
o	Maintenance contract
o	Periodic maintenance certificates (last five years)
o	Reports of the inspections carried out (since the first one)
o	Characterisation of the establishment in terms of fire safety: building type and intrinsic risk level. The INSHT provides the Intrinsic Risk Level Calculator for industrial establishments.
o	Report on the deficiencies observed at the last inspection, with the corrective actions and their completion date.
o	Calculation of the fire load to determine whether a self-protection plan must be developed
o	Develop the plan with all the information required by the various chapters and annexes
El Plan de Emergencias si está implantad: The Emergency Plan is in place; staff have been trained and a drill has been carried out.
Inspección de vías de evacuación: mensua: Inspection of evacuation routes: monthly. Emergency lighting test: monthly (30 sec) + annual (1 hour). Signage: check after any change of layout (RD 486/1997)
Las instalaciones de protección contra i: Fire protection installations (extinguishers, BIEs (fire hose reels), sprinklers, detection) must be installed and maintained by authorised companies, with current maintenance contracts and up-to-date certificates
¿El mantenimiento de las instalaciones P: Is the maintenance of the PCI (fire protection) installations (extinguishers, BIEs, detection, sprinklers) carried out by a maintenance company authorised by the CCAA (regional government)? Are the maintenance certificates for the last 5 years available?
Contrato de mantenimiento vigente con em: Current maintenance contract with an authorised company + PCI maintenance certificates for the last 5 years + proof of the maintenance company's authorisation
Extintores: revisión semestral (visual): Extinguishers: six-monthly inspection (visual) + annual (technical) + pressure re-test every 5 years. BIEs: quarterly (visual) + annual (technical). Sprinklers: quarterly + annual. Detection: quarterly + annual
Mantenimiento extintores: semestral + an: Extinguisher maintenance: six-monthly + annual technical + pressure re-test every 5 years. BIEs: quarterly + annual. Sprinklers and detection: quarterly + annual. Certificates: keep for 5 years (RD 513/2017)
Todos los equipos y componentes de prote: All fire protection equipment and components must bear CE marking and have been installed by an authorised company, with a design or technical documentation for the installation
¿Todos los equipos PCI (extintores, dete: Does all PCI equipment (extinguishers, detectors, BIEs, sprinklers) have CE marking? Is there a design or technical documentation for the PCI installation signed by a competent technician?
Fichas técnicas de equipos PCI con marca: Technical data sheets for PCI equipment with CE marking + design or technical documentation for the installation + installer's certificate
Guardar el proyecto de instalación PCI p: Keep the PCI installation design permanently. When replacing equipment, check that the new items have CE marking. The installer must be authorised in the CCAA where the installation is located
Verificación de marcado CE: al adquirir: Verification of CE marking: on acquiring each item of PCI equipment. Installation documentation: keep permanently (RD 513/2017)
El establecimiento industrial debe estar: The industrial establishment must be characterised by its intrinsic risk level and undergo OCA inspections at the frequency set by that risk level (low: 5 years, medium: 3 years, high: 2 years)
¿Se ha calculado el nivel de riesgo intr: Has the establishment's intrinsic risk level been calculated? Are OCA inspections carried out at the correct frequency? Are the reports of all inspections carried out kept?
Cálculo del nivel de riesgo intrínseco (: Calculation of the intrinsic risk level (INSST calculator) + OCA inspection reports since the first one + corrective action plan from the last inspection
Usar el calculador de riesgo intrínseco: Use the INSST/INSHT intrinsic risk calculator. The risk level determines the frequency of OCA inspections. Deficiencies detected must be corrected within the period stated in the report
Hay que documentar porqué no se necesita:
It must be documented why a self-protection plan is not required.
The training given should also be reviewed, as we have found key people in this procedure who may not be fully aware of their role
Inspección OCA: cada 5 años (bajo) / cad: OCA inspection: every 5 years (low) / every 3 years (medium) / every 2 years (high). Reports: keep permanently. Corrective action plan: draw up immediately after receiving the report (RD 2267/2004)
Las deficiencias detectadas en las inspe: Deficiencies detected in OCA fire protection inspections must be corrected within the period set in the report and notified to the competent body if they are serious deficiencies
¿Se dispone del informe de deficiencias: Is the deficiency report from the last OCA inspection available? Have the corrective actions been carried out within the stated deadlines? Has the rectification been notified to the competent body where required?
Acta de la última inspección OCA + regis: Report of the last OCA inspection + record of corrective actions with completion dates + notification of rectification where applicable
Las deficiencias graves pueden implicar: Serious deficiencies may lead to the suspension of the activity by the competent body. Always prioritise active safety deficiencies (detection, extinguishing) over passive ones (fire resistance)
Acciones correctoras de deficiencias OCA: Corrective actions for OCA deficiencies: within the period stated in the report. Where the report sets no specific deadline: carry out within a reasonable period and document (RD 2267/2004)
Si se produce un incendio con consecuenc: If a fire with significant consequences occurs, the holder must notify the competent body of the CCAA within a maximum of 15 days
¿Existe un procedimiento para comunicar: Is there a procedure for notifying fires with significant consequences to the competent body of the CCAA within 15 days? Is there a record of fires that have occurred?
Procedimiento de comunicación de incendi: Fire notification procedure + records of fires that have occurred + notifications made to the CCAA where applicable
Aunque no haya habido incendios, tener e: Even if there have been no fires, have the procedure documented. The notification must include: a description of the fire, harm to people and damage to property, and the measures taken
Comunicación a CCAA: en el plazo máximo: Notification to the CCAA: within a maximum of 15 days of a fire with significant consequences. Procedure: annual review (RD 2267/2004)
Si la carga de fuego ponderada y corregi: If the establishment's weighted and corrected fire load is ≥3,200 Mcal/m² (high intrinsic risk, level 8), it is mandatory to draw up a Self-Protection Plan and register it with the CCAA
¿Se ha calculado la carga de fuego del e: Has the establishment's fire load been calculated and has it been determined whether it exceeds the threshold requiring a Self-Protection Plan? If applicable, has the plan been drawn up, implemented and entered in the CCAA register?
Cálculo de carga de fuego + Plan de Auto: Fire load calculation + Self-Protection Plan with all the chapters of Annex II of RD 393/2007 + proof of registration with the CCAA + drill records
Usar el calculador de riesgo intrínseco: Use the INSST intrinsic risk calculator. If the level is below the threshold, the PA (self-protection plan) is not mandatory, although the Emergency Plan under Ley 31/1995 is. Document the calculation in any case
Plan de Autoprotección: elaborar si apli: Self-Protection Plan: draw up, if applicable, before the activity starts. Review and update: annual + after any significant change. Drills: at least 1 per year (RD 393/2007)
Los equipos de lucha contra incendios de: Firefighting equipment must be accessible, marked with standardised signage, free of obstructions that would prevent its use and in locations known to all workers
¿Los extintores y BIEs están accesibles: Are extinguishers and BIEs accessible without obstruction, signposted and in positions known to workers? Have workers received training in their use?
Fotografías de ubicación y señalización: Photographs of the location and signage of PCI equipment + records of worker training in the use of extinguishers + extinguisher use drill
La señalización de equipos PCI debe ser: Signage for PCI equipment must be photoluminescent. The access area to the extinguisher must be kept free of goods. Training in the use of extinguishers must include practice with real fire or a simulator
Formación en uso de extintores: inicial: Training in the use of extinguishers: initial + refresher every 2-3 years. Inspection of PCI equipment accessibility: monthly (RD 486/1997 + RD 513/2017)
El empresario titular del centro debe in: The employer who owns the workplace must inform concurrent companies in writing of the site's risks and emergency measures before work begins, especially where the risks are serious or very serious
¿Se entrega por escrito a cada contratis: Is each contractor given written information, before starting work, on the site's risks and the applicable emergency measures? Is a signed acknowledgement of receipt obtained?
Documentos de información de riesgos del: Site risk information documents delivered to each contractor + signed acknowledgement of receipt + procedure for delivering CAE (coordination of business activities) information
La información debe entregarse antes del: The information must be delivered before the first day of work and updated if the site's risks change. Where the risks are serious or very serious, it must always be in writing
o\tPlataforma CAE para recoger todos los:
o	CAE platform to collect all the documents required by occupational risk prevention regulations. (this is already in place)
o	Written record of a work permit covering both the risks inherent in the work itself and the particular risks that the work environment may present at that time.
o	Keep a record, on the permit or elsewhere, of the presence of a preventive resource when deemed necessary.
Entrega de información de riesgos: antes: Delivery of risk information: before the start of each contract. Update: when the site's risks change or a new contractor is engaged (RD 171/2004 Art. 7)
Las empresas que contraten actividades p: Companies that contract out activities forming part of their own business at their site must monitor the PRL (occupational risk prevention) compliance of their contractors and subcontractors through a CAE platform or equivalent system
¿Existe una plataforma CAE o sistema equ: Is there an operational CAE platform or equivalent system for managing contractors' PRL documentation? Is each contractor's documentation verified before access to the site is authorised?
Plataforma CAE operativa + documentos PR: Operational CAE platform + PRL documents verified per contractor (risk assessment, training, health surveillance, insurance) + evidence of verification prior to access
La plataforma CAE debe incluir como míni: The CAE platform must include as a minimum: risk assessment of the contracted activity, worker training, health surveillance and proof of insurance. Update when documents expire
Verificación CAE: antes del inicio de ca: CAE verification: before the start of each contract. Document updates: according to expiry. Audit of the CAE system: annual (RD 171/2004 Art. 10)
Los empresarios cuyos trabajadores actúa: Employers whose workers operate at third-party premises (maintenance, cleaning) must ensure safety at those sites and coordinate with the site owner
¿Cuando los trabajadores propios trabaja: When our own workers work at client or third-party premises, are they given information on the specific risks of those premises? Is there coordination with the site owner before work starts?
Registros de información facilitada a tr: Records of information provided to workers before working at third-party premises + proof of coordination with the site owner
El empresario que envía trabajadores a i: The employer sending workers to third-party premises must: request risk information from the site owner, pass it on to its workers and establish coordination before work begins
Información previa al trabajador: antes: Prior information to the worker: before each visit to third-party premises. Coordination with the site owner: before the start and ongoing during the work (RD 171/2004 Art. 4)
Cuando existan actividades con riesgo es: Where there are activities involving special risk (ATEX, height, electrical work), a preventive resource with at least basic-level training must be designated and remain present throughout the activity
¿Se designa un recurso preventivo con fo: Is a preventive resource with basic-level PRL training designated for all special-risk activities carried out by contractors on site? Is their presence during the work recorded?
Designación escrita del recurso preventi: Written designation of the preventive resource per activity + proof of training (minimum basic level) + record of their presence on the work permit or equivalent document
El recurso preventivo debe tener formaci: The preventive resource must have, as a minimum, basic-level PRL training (50 hours). They may be our own worker or the contractor's. They must remain on site throughout the risk activity
Designación del recurso preventivo: ante: Designation of the preventive resource: before each activity requiring one. Record of presence: throughout the activity. Verification of training: on designation + annual review (Ley 31/1995 Art. 32 bis)
Los trabajos con riesgo especial realiza: Special-risk work carried out by contractors must be controlled through written work permits that set out the risks of the work and of the environment at that time
¿Existe un sistema de permisos de trabaj: Is there a work permit system for contractors' special-risk work (ATEX, height, electricity, confined spaces)? Do the permits record the specific risks of the environment at the time of the work?
Modelo de permiso de trabajo + registros: Work permit template + records of permits issued + procedure for managing work permits for contractors
El permiso de trabajo debe recoger: los: The work permit must set out: the risks inherent in the work and the risks of the environment at that specific time (not only the site's usual risks). Include the signature of the preventive resource where mandatory
Permiso de trabajo: emitido para cada ac: Work permit: issued for each special-risk activity. Permit archive: keep in accordance with internal policy (minimum 1 year recommended). Procedure review: annual (RD 171/2004)
Las operaciones de carga/descarga que im: Loading/unloading operations involving MMC (manual handling of loads) over 3 kg must be ergonomically assessed, with mechanical aids provided when loads exceed the recommended limits
¿Se han evaluado ergonómicamente las tar: Have packing and unpacking tasks been ergonomically assessed? Are mechanical handling aids (trolleys, lifts, lifting tables) available for loads exceeding the recommended limits?
Evaluación ergonómica de tareas de carga: Ergonomic assessment of loading and unloading tasks + inventory of available mechanical aids + MMC training records for this job
Las operaciones de carga/descarga combin: Loading/unloading operations frequently combine: repetitive lifting, awkward postures and handling in unfavourable conditions. Also assess the frequency and duration of the tasks
•\tEvaluación de riesgo teniendo en cuen:
•	Risk assessment taking into account the requirements of this Royal Decree, as well as NTP 1076: Loading and unloading docks: safety..
•	Transfer the opportunities arising from this assessment to the preventive activity action plan
Evaluación ergonómica de MMC en embalaje: Ergonomic MMC assessment for packing/unpacking: initial + annual review or when loads or procedures change (RD 487/1997)
Los trabajadores que realizan operacione: Workers who carry out packing and unpacking operations must receive specific training in correct handling techniques and in the use of the mechanical handling aids available
¿Los trabajadores de embalaje y desembal: Have packing and unpacking workers received training in correct MMC techniques and in the use of the available mechanical aids? Are there signed records of this training?
Registros de formación en MMC y uso de m: Records of training in MMC and use of mechanical aids signed by the workers + job-specific training programme
La formación debe ser práctica y específ: Training must be practical and specific to the actual tasks of the job. Include: lifting techniques, correct use of trolleys and lifts, and how to ask for help when the load exceeds the limits
Formación inicial: al incorporarse al pu: Initial training: on joining the job. Refresher: annual or when tasks, loads or available aids change (RD 487/1997 Art. 4)
Las zonas de carga y descarga deben disp: Loading and unloading areas must have adequate lighting (minimum 200 lux for warehouse work, 500 lux for more precise tasks) and adequate environmental conditions
¿Se han medido los niveles de iluminació: Have lighting levels been measured in the packing and unpacking areas? Are the minimums of Annex IV of RD 486/1997 met? Are the environmental conditions (temperature, ventilation) suitable for the work?
Informe de medición de iluminación en zo: Lighting measurement report for packing/unpacking areas + measurements of environmental conditions + improvement plan if there are deficiencies
Las tareas de embalaje con etiquetado o: Packing tasks involving labelling or quality inspection may require 500 lux. Also check that the temperature is adequate: work in these areas may be more sedentary and workers may feel colder
Medición de iluminación: anual + cuando: Lighting measurement: annual + when installations or layout change. Measurement of environmental conditions: annual (RD 486/1997 Annexes III and IV)
Los equipos utilizados en carga (flejad: Equipment used in loading (strapping machines, winding machines, film wrappers) must have CE marking, safety guards on moving parts and documented preventive maintenance
¿Los equipos de carga (flejadoras, bobin: Does the loading equipment (strapping machines, winding machines, wrappers) have CE marking and a declaration of conformity? Does it have guards on all dangerous moving parts? Is there a preventive maintenance plan for each item of equipment?
Marcado CE + declaraciones de conformida: CE marking + declarations of conformity for packing equipment + inventory of guards installed + preventive maintenance plan per item of equipment
Las bobinadoras tienen el manual de inst: The winding machines have their instruction manual available via QR code. Steel strapping machines and wrappers have parts that can cause cuts and entrapment — check that the guards are fitted and in good condition
Verificación de CE y guardas: al adquiri: Verification of CE marking and guards: on acquiring the equipment. Preventive maintenance: according to the manufacturer. Guard inspection: before each shift (RD 1215/1997 Annex I)
Inventario completo de sustancias y mezc: Complete inventory of hazardous substances and mixtures, with up-to-date safety data sheets (SDS) accessible at the points of use
¿Existe un inventario actualizado de tod: Is there an up-to-date inventory of all hazardous substances at the plant, with SDS in Spanish (version ≤5 years old) accessible at each point of use?
Inventario de sustancias peligrosas + FD: Inventory of hazardous substances + up-to-date SDS per substance + evidence of accessibility at workstations (physical folders or digital system)
Las FDS deben estar en castellano y ser: SDS must be in Spanish and be the supplier's most recent version; check that they are accessible to workers at the point of use, not only in the office
Inventario de agentes químicos + FDS act: Inventory of chemical agents + up-to-date SDS (≤5 years) accessible at each workstation
Inventario: actualización continua (alta: Inventory: continuous updating (substances added/removed). SDS: review whenever the supplier issues an update, or every 5 years at most (RD 374/2001 + CLP Regulation)
RD 374/2001 Art. 3-4 + Documentación sob: RD 374/2001 Art. 3-4 + INSST documentation on VLA (occupational exposure limit values)
Evaluación cuantitativa de la exposición: Quantitative assessment of workers' exposure to chemical agents by means of workplace air measurements compared against the INSST VLA
¿Se han realizado mediciones de la expos: Have exposure measurements been taken for the main chemical contaminants by workstation? Have the results been compared with the INSST VLA-ED and VLA-EC (8-hour and short-term exposure limits)?
Informes de medición de higiene industri: Industrial hygiene measurement reports by agent + comparison with the INSST VLA + action plan if the action values are exceeded
Las mediciones deben realizarse por higi: Measurements must be taken by an accredited industrial hygienist; if the VLA are exceeded, a preventive action plan is mandatory, giving priority to collective protection
Informes de medición higiénica por agent: Hygiene measurement reports by agent + comparison with VLA-ED and VLA-EC + action plan
Mediciones de exposición: anual para con: Exposure measurements: annual for contaminants with a VLA-ED; whenever the process or substances change. If the VLA are exceeded: more frequent measurements (RD 374/2001 Art. 3-4)
Identificación y control de agentes canc: Identification and control of carcinogenic or mutagenic agents present at the plant, with individual exposure records kept for 40 years
¿Están identificados todos los agentes c: Have all carcinogenic or mutagenic agents at the plant been identified (welding fumes, silica, hexavalent chromium, benzene)? Do exposed workers have individual exposure records?
Inventario de agentes cancerígenos + reg: Inventory of carcinogenic agents + individual exposure records per worker + documented substitution or reduction measures + notification to the health authority where applicable
Los registros de exposición a cancerígen: Records of exposure to carcinogens must be kept for 40 years; include welding fumes (hexavalent chromium and nickel) and crystalline silica in stone or glass machining operations
Inventario de cancerígenos + registros d: Inventory of carcinogens + individual exposure records (keep for 40 years) + reduction measures
Evaluación de exposición a cancerígenos:: Assessment of exposure to carcinogens: annual. Individual exposure records: keep for 40 years after the activity ceases. Notification to the health authority where applicable (RD 665/1997)
RD 374/2001 + RD 379/2001 (almacenamient: RD 374/2001 + RD 379/2001 (storage of chemical products) + NTP 725 INSST
Almacenamiento seguro de productos quími: Safe storage of hazardous chemical products: compatibilities, ventilation, retention bunds, CLP labelling and signage
¿El almacén de productos químicos tiene: Does the chemical store have adequate ventilation, retention bunds, segregation of incompatible products and CLP labelling on all containers?
Inspección del almacén de químicos + pla: Inspection of the chemical store + layout plan showing compatibilities + ventilation certificate + emergency information sheets in the store
Verificar que los recipientes están iden: Verify that containers are identified with CLP labelling and that the quantities stored do not exceed the regulatory limits of RD 379/2001 for the categories present
Plano de almacén con compatibilidades +: Store layout plan with compatibilities + ventilation certificate + CLP labelling on all containers
Inspección del almacén de químicos: mens: Inspection of the chemical store: monthly (visual) + six-monthly (technical). Compatibility review: whenever a new substance is introduced (RD 379/2001 + NTP 725)
Ley 7/2022 de residuos y suelos contamin: Ley 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils + RD 553/2020
Gestión, identificación, segregación y d: Management, identification, segregation and documentation of hazardous industrial waste: register, authorised waste manager and maximum storage time
¿Los residuos peligrosos están identific: Is hazardous waste identified, labelled and segregated at the point of generation? Is there an up-to-date register and an authorised waste manager with a valid contract?
Libro de registro de residuos peligrosos: Up-to-date hazardous waste register + waste manager acceptance forms + contracts with authorised waste managers + compliant labelling on all drums and containers
Una planta de fabricación mixta puede ge: A mixed manufacturing plant may generate multiple types of hazardous waste (used oils, solvents, contaminated rags, fluorescent tubes); the maximum storage time at the producer's premises is 6 months
Libro de registro de residuos peligrosos: Up-to-date hazardous waste register + contracts with waste managers + compliant labelling
Libro de registro: actualización continu: Register: updated continuously with every waste movement. Waste manager: verify valid authorisation annually. Maximum storage time at the producer's premises: 6 months (Ley 7/2022)
Ley 7/2007 de 9 de julio, de Gestión Int: Ley 7/2007 of 9 July on Integrated Environmental Quality Management of Andalusia (GICA) + Decreto 356/2010 on the GICA Activities Regulation + Seville City Council Municipal Ordinance on Planning and Activity Licences
El almacén de Sevilla debe contar con la: The Seville warehouse must hold the Calificación Ambiental (environmental classification, for lower-impact activities) or the Licencia Ambiental (environmental licence, for activities with greater environmental impact) issued by Seville City Council under Ley 7/2007 GICA, or the Autorización Ambiental Unificada (AAU, unified environmental authorisation) from the Regional Ministry of Sustainability, Environment and Blue Economy of the Junta de Andalucía if the activity falls under Annex I or II of the GICA. Without the corresponding authorisation the warehouse cannot operate legally in Andalusia.
¿El almacén de Sevilla dispone de Califi: Does the Seville warehouse hold a valid Calificación Ambiental, Licencia Ambiental or AAU, issued by Seville City Council or the Regional Ministry of Sustainability of the Junta de Andalucía as appropriate? Does the authorisation cover the activity, floor area and products currently stored?
Calificación Ambiental o Licencia Ambien: Valid Calificación Ambiental, Licencia Ambiental or AAU + municipal certificate of urban planning compatibility from Seville City Council + receipt for the latest payment of fees or I.A.E. (business activity tax)
La Ley 7/2007 GICA clasifica las activid: Ley 7/2007 GICA classifies activities in Andalusia into three categories according to environmental impact: Autorización Ambiental Integrada (AAI, integrated environmental authorisation — Annex I, responsibility of the Junta de Andalucía), Autorización Ambiental Unificada (AAU — Annex II, Junta de Andalucía) and Calificación Ambiental (Annex I of the Regulation — City Council). Most warehouses fall under the Calificación Ambiental or Licencia Ambiental managed by Seville City Council. Any extension, change of use or change in the products stored may require an amendment to be processed with Seville City Council.

NOM-004-STPS-1999 — paros de emergencia: NOM-004-STPS-1999 — emergency stops on warehouse machinery
Prueba funcional de paros de emergencia:: Emergency stop functional test: monthly. Visual inspection before each shift as part of the pre-use check (NOM-004-STPS-1999)
Solo los operadores capacitados y formal: Only trained and formally authorised operators may use warehouse machinery.
¿Todos los operadores de maquinaria tien: Do all machinery operators have documented training specific to each machine they operate? Is there a formal authorisation list by machine and operator?
Registros de capacitación por operador y: Training records by operator and machine + authorisation list by machine + competence verification records
Mantener autorización separada para cada: Maintain a separate authorisation for each type of machine. Withdraw authorisation if the operator displays unsafe behaviour. Update the list when personnel change.
NOM-004-STPS-1999 — capacitación y autor: NOM-004-STPS-1999 — training and formal authorisation of machinery operators
Capacitación de operadores: inicial ante: Operator training: initial before first use + annual refresher. Review of the authorisation list: annual + when personnel change (NOM-004-STPS-1999)
Todos los equipos de trabajo del almacén: All warehouse work equipment with dangerous moving parts (conveyor belts, wrapping machines, balers, dock levellers) must have guards and protective devices that prevent access to danger zones during operation.
¿Todos los equipos del almacén con parte: Does all warehouse equipment with moving parts have guards preventing access during operation? Are the guards in good condition and have they not been removed or modified? Are they inspected before each shift?
Bitácora de inspección de guardas antes: Guard inspection log before each shift + risk assessment of moving parts per item of equipment + guard maintenance records
Las guardas no deben poder retirarse sin: Guards must not be removable without a tool. Never operate a machine without guards under any circumstances. Document any temporary removal of a guard in the maintenance log and verify its reinstallation.
Bitácora de inspección de guardas + eval: Guard inspection log + risk assessment of moving parts + maintenance records
faltan guardas de extractores de ventila: Guards missing on ventilation extractor fans
Inspección de guardas: antes de cada tur: Guard inspection: before each shift (operator) + formal monthly (supervisor). Review of the entrapment risk assessment: annual (NOM-004-STPS-1999)
Todas las máquinas del almacén deben dis: All warehouse machines must have emergency stop devices (latching red mushroom head) accessible from the operating position, in good working order and checked monthly.
¿Todos los equipos de trabajo del almacé: Does all warehouse work equipment have a latching red mushroom-head emergency stop accessible from the operating position? Are they functionally checked every month and are the results documented?
Registros de verificación funcional mens: Records of monthly functional checks of emergency stops + photographic identification of locations + reset procedure after activation
Los paros de emergencia deben ser de cab: Emergency stops must have a red head on a yellow background, be of the automatic latching type (lock in when activated) and require deliberate resetting. Check that they are accessible and visible without obstruction from the workstation.
Registros de verificación funcional mens: Records of monthly functional checks of emergency stops + register of locations
Verificación funcional de paros de emerg: Functional check of emergency stops: monthly. Visual inspection: before each shift as part of the pre-use check of each item of equipment (NOM-004-STPS-1999)
Debe implementarse un procedimiento de b: A hazardous energy lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure must be implemented, applicable to all maintenance or repair work on warehouse equipment. Every worker working on equipment must have their own personal padlock.
¿Existe un procedimiento LOTO documentad: Is there a documented LOTO procedure known to the warehouse maintenance personnel? Does every worker carrying out interventions have their own personal LOTO padlock? Are all LOTO applications recorded?
Procedimiento LOTO documentado por equip: Documented LOTO procedure per item of equipment + inventory of lockout devices (padlocks, hasps, lock boxes) + LOTO training records + application log
Cada trabajador que opera en equipos ais: Every worker working on isolated equipment must have their own personal padlock. Never remove another worker's padlock. The LOTO procedure must cover all types of energy: electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic and gravitational.
Procedimiento LOTO por equipo + inventar: LOTO procedure per item of equipment + device inventory + training records + application log
Procedimiento LOTO: aplicar en cada inte: LOTO procedure: apply at every maintenance intervention. Annual review of the procedure. Training: initial + annual. Application audit: quarterly (NOM-004-STPS-1999)
Los equipos de trabajo deben incluir en: Work equipment must include in its maintenance plan the periodic verification of anti-entrapment safety systems: guards, emergency stops, interlocking devices and presence sensors.
¿El plan de mantenimiento preventivo de: Does the preventive maintenance plan for each warehouse machine include specific verification of anti-entrapment safety systems? Do the maintenance records distinguish between operational maintenance and safety verification?
Plan de mantenimiento con sección especí: Maintenance plan with a specific section on safety systems per item of equipment + signed preventive maintenance records with a safety section + corrective action records
El mantenimiento de seguridad debe docum: Safety maintenance must be documented separately from operational maintenance. A machine that works correctly but has deteriorated guards or faulty emergency stops is as dangerous as a broken-down machine.
Plan de mantenimiento con sección de seg: Maintenance plan with safety section + maintenance records with verification of safety devices
Verificación de sistemas de seguridad an: Verification of anti-entrapment safety systems: at each preventive maintenance. Records: retain for the service life of the equipment (NOM-004-STPS-1999)
