Forklifts certified and inspected before use
All forklift operators must be trained, certified in accordance with NOM-006 and formally authorised before operating industrial equipment.
¿Todos los operadores de montacargas tie: Do all forklift operators hold valid NOM-006 training certification? Is there an authorisation list by forklift type and operator? Is recertification scheduled?
Certificados de equipos, DC3 de operador: Equipment certificates, DC-3 for forklift operators (NOM-006) + internal authorisation list per item of equipment + recertification schedule
La certificación NOM-006 debe ser especí: NOM-006 certification must be specific to the forklift type (counterbalance, reach truck, stacker, pallet truck). The same certificate is not valid for all truck types.
NOM-006-STPS-2014 — capacitación y certi: NOM-006-STPS-2014 — training and certification of forklift truck operators
Capacitación inicial de operadores de mo: Initial forklift operator training: before first use. Recertification: every 2 years. Review of the authorisation list: annual (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Las montacargas deben inspeccionarse ant: Forklifts must be inspected before each work shift using a standardised checklist. Defective forklifts must be taken out of service immediately.
¿Se completa una lista de verificación p: Is a pre-shift checklist completed before using each forklift? Are forklifts with defects taken out of service and not operated until repaired?
Listas de verificación previa al turno d: Pre-shift checklists for the last month + defect and repair records
La lista de verificación debe cubrir: fr: The checklist must cover: brakes, steering, tyres, forks, mast, hydraulic system, lights, horn, seat belt and charge/battery level.
NOM-006-STPS-2014 — inspección previa al: NOM-006-STPS-2014 — pre-shift inspection of forklift trucks
Inspección previa al turno: antes de cad: Pre-shift inspection: before each use. Annual technical inspection by an authorised service provider. Records retained for at least 1 year (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Deben establecerse y respetarse rutas de: Separate, clearly defined traffic routes for forklifts and pedestrians must be established and observed throughout the warehouse.
¿Las rutas de montacargas y las zonas pe: Are forklift routes and pedestrian areas physically separated or clearly marked? Are speed limits signposted? Are forklift/pedestrian crossings marked with mirrors and warning signs?
Plan de gestión de tráfico del almacén +: Warehouse traffic management plan + photographs of route and pedestrian crossing markings + speed limit signs
Las colisiones carretilla/peatón son la: Forklift/pedestrian collisions are the main cause of fatal accidents in warehouses. Use physical barriers wherever possible. Convex mirrors are mandatory at all blind spots.
NOM-001-STPS-2008 + NOM-006-STPS-2014 +: NOM-001-STPS-2008 + NOM-006-STPS-2014 + NOM-026-STPS-2008 — forklift and pedestrian traffic management in the warehouse
Traffic route inspection: monthly. Update the traffic plan when the warehouse layout changes (NOM-006-STPS-2014 + NOM-001-STPS-2008)
Los sistemas de estanterías y racks debe: Shelving and racking systems must be correctly installed, regularly inspected and loaded without exceeding the displayed maximum capacity.
¿Los sistemas de racks están instalados: Are racking systems installed according to the manufacturer's specifications, with visible maximum load capacity signs? Are they inspected monthly and is damage repaired immediately?
Registros de instalación de racks + bitá: Racking installation records + periodic inspection log + damage repair records
Nunca superar la capacidad nominal del r: Never exceed the rated capacity of the racking. Replace damaged components immediately — never straighten damaged components. Racking uprights exposed to forklift traffic must be protected.
NOM-006-STPS-2014 — seguridad en sistema: NOM-006-STPS-2014 — safety of warehouse shelving and racking systems
Inspección de racks: mensual formal + di: Racking inspection: formal monthly + daily operational. Annual inspection by a specialist racking inspector. Damage repair: immediately on detection (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Los palets deben estar en buenas condici: Pallets must be in good condition, loads must be stable and stacking heights must not exceed established safe limits.
¿Los palets se inspeccionan antes de su: Are pallets inspected before use and defective ones removed? Are loads strapped, shrink-wrapped or otherwise secured to prevent falls? Are maximum stacking heights displayed in each area?
Procedimiento de inspección de palets +: Pallet inspection procedure + load securing standards + stacking height limits displayed by area
Los palets de madera dañados son una de: Damaged wooden pallets are one of the main causes of forklift incidents and falling loads. Implement a system for inspecting and discarding pallets before each use.
NOM-006-STPS-2014 — seguridad en palets: NOM-006-STPS-2014 — pallet safety and load stability in the warehouse
Pallet inspection: before each use. Load stability check: before each forklift movement. Stacking heights: permanently displayed by area (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Las vías de circulación situadas en zona: Traffic routes located in high-level storage areas must be protected with barriers, and access restriction procedures must be applied during racking loading or unloading operations.
¿Las vías de paso bajo zonas de almacena: Are walkways beneath high-level storage areas protected with barriers and access restriction signage? Is there a procedure for restricting pedestrian movement during high-level loading operations?
Fotografías de vías protegidas bajo zona: Photographs of protected routes beneath high-level storage areas + access restriction procedure + protection inspection records
Si no es posible la protección física pe: If permanent physical protection is not possible, establish a signposted no-entry system during high-level loading operations. Workers in adjacent areas must be informed before any high-level loading operation begins.
Fotografías de protecciones + procedimie: Photographs of protections + access restriction procedure + monthly inspection records
Inspección de protecciones bajo almacena: Inspection of protections beneath high-level storage: monthly. Review of the access restriction procedure: annually or after any incident (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Las estanterías del almacén deben estar: Warehouse racking must be anchored, with the maximum load displayed per level and bay. Racking damage detected during operations must be reported immediately and the affected bay taken out of service until repaired.
¿Las estanterías están ancladas al suelo: Is the racking anchored to the floor in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications? Does it have visible maximum load signs per level and per bay? Is there a damage reporting system accessible to operators?
Documentación del instalador de estanter: Racking installer documentation + maximum load signs per bay/level + damage reporting system (tags, QR codes) + damage and repair records
Las columnas de racks expuestos al tráfi: Racking uprights exposed to forklift traffic must have protectors. Damaged components compromise the integrity of the entire racking. Never straighten damaged sections — replace the complete component.
Documentación instalador + señalización: Installer documentation + maximum load signs + damage reporting system + repair records
Inspección mensual de estanterías: por o: Monthly racking inspection: by operator + supervisor. Annual technical inspection: by a specialist inspector. Damage repair: immediately on detection (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Los equipos de elevación del almacén (pu: Warehouse lifting equipment (overhead cranes, hoists) must have working safety devices, and hooks must have safety latches to prevent the load from falling accidentally.
¿Los equipos de elevación (puentes grúa,: Does the lifting equipment (overhead cranes, hoists) have safety brakes that are checked at each maintenance? Do hooks have operational safety latches that are checked before each use?
Certificación de dispositivos de segurid: Certification of lifting equipment safety devices + hook latch checks + maintenance records + pre-use inspection records
Los pestillos de seguridad de los gancho: Hook safety latches must be checked before each use. Safety devices must be checked periodically. A suspended load without safety controls can fall with fatal consequences.
Certificación de dispositivos de segurid: Certification of safety devices + latch check records + lifting equipment usage log
Inspección de pestillos de gancho: antes: Hook latch inspection: before each use. Safety brake check: at each periodic maintenance. Lifting equipment maintenance: per the manufacturer's plan (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Los dispositivos de izaje (eslingas text: Lifting accessories (textile slings, wire rope slings, chains, shackles) must be inspected before each use, have the safe working load (SWL) visibly marked and be withdrawn immediately if damaged.
¿Todos los accesorios de izaje tienen la: Do all lifting accessories have the SWL visibly marked? Is there a pre-use inspection procedure for slings and shackles? Are deteriorated accessories withdrawn from service immediately?
Inventario de accesorios de izado con CM: Inventory of lifting accessories with SWL + pre-use inspection procedure + records of withdrawal of deteriorated accessories
Las eslingas textiles deben retirarse si: Textile slings must be withdrawn if they show cuts, fraying, deformation, acid stains or colour degradation due to heat. Chains: never weld, never knot. Shackles: check that the pin is secured with a split pin before each lift.
Inventario de accesorios de izado con CM: Inventory of lifting accessories with SWL + pre-use inspection procedure + records of withdrawal of deteriorated accessories
Inspección de accesorios de izaje: antes: Inspection of lifting accessories: before each use (visual). Periodic formal inspection: according to the type of accessory and frequency of use. Withdrawal of deteriorated accessories: immediate (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Los andenes de carga deben contar con pr: Loading docks must have fall protection, wheel chocks, dock levellers and safe communication procedures during loading and unloading operations.
¿Se usan calzas de ruedas para inmoviliz: Are wheel chocks used to immobilise vehicles before loading/unloading begins? Do the dock edges have physical protection? Is there a communication procedure between the lorry driver and the forklift operator?
Procedimiento de seguridad en andenes +: Loading dock safety procedure + inventory of wheel chocks + photographs of dock protection + driver training records
riesgos de caída desde un anden de carga: Risk of falling from a loading dock. Docks without a lorry must have barriers. Wheel chocks are mandatory before any loading/unloading operation.
NOM-006-STPS-2014 — seguridad en andenes: NOM-006-STPS-2014 — safety at warehouse loading and unloading docks
Procedimiento de andenes: aplicar en cad: Dock procedure: apply at every loading/unloading operation. Inspection of dock equipment. Immediate repair of damaged protections (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Los andenes de carga deben disponer de;: Loading docks must have: wheel chocks to immobilise vehicles before any loading or unloading operation begins, and fall protection at docks with no vehicle present.
¿Se utilizan calzas de ruedas en todos l: Are wheel chocks used on all vehicles before loading/unloading begins? Do docks with no vehicle parked have protections? Is there a documented dock operating procedure?
Procedimiento escrito de operación en an: Written dock operating procedure + inventory of wheel chocks + photographs of dock protections + records of briefings to transport drivers
Las calzas deben colocarse antes de que: Chocks must be placed before the driver leaves the cab. Dock protection barriers must be functional — vehicles must not enter the dock without approval from warehouse personnel
Procedimiento de andenes + inventario ca: Dock procedure + chock inventory + photographs of protections + records of training and communication to drivers
Revisión del procedimiento de muelle: an: Review of the dock procedure: annually or after any incident. Wheel chock inspection: monthly. Dock protection inspection: monthly (NOM-006-STPS-2014 + NOM-001-STPS-2008)
Las puertas automáticas de carga del alm: Automatic warehouse loading doors must have anti-entrapment safety devices (photoelectric cells, safety edges) and be included in the six-monthly preventive maintenance plan carried out by an authorised company.
¿Las puertas automáticas de carga tienen: Do the automatic loading doors have photoelectric cells and/or safety edges that stop closing when a presence is detected? Is there a six-monthly maintenance plan for the automatic doors carried out by an authorised company?
Certificado de los dispositivos de segur: Certificate for the door safety devices + result of functional check at each maintenance + six-monthly maintenance records signed by an authorised company
Las células fotoeléctricas deben cubrir: Photoelectric cells must cover the full height of the opening. Safety edges must reverse the movement immediately on contact. Check the operation of all safety devices at each maintenance. An automatic door without anti-entrapment devices in good condition is a serious hazard.
Certificado dispositivos de seguridad +: Safety device certificate + functional check records + six-monthly maintenance records
Mantenimiento de puertas automáticas: se: Automatic door maintenance: six-monthly by an authorised company. Functional check of safety devices: at each six-monthly maintenance. Daily visual inspection: before each shift (NOM-006-STPS-2014)
Las operaciones de carga y descarga que: Loading and unloading operations involving manual handling of loads must be ergonomically assessed, and mechanical aids must be provided where loads exceed the recommended limits. Packaging equipment (strapping machines, wrappers, winders) must have conformity marking and guards at all danger points.
¿Se han evaluado ergonómicamente las tar: Have the warehouse loading and unloading tasks been ergonomically assessed? Does the packaging equipment (strapping machines, wrappers) have guards at all dangerous contact points, and is it included in the preventive maintenance plan?
Evaluación ergonómica de tareas de carga: Ergonomic assessment of loading and unloading tasks + inventory of packaging equipment with guard verification + packaging equipment maintenance records
Las operaciones de embalaje combinan fre: Packaging operations frequently combine repetitive lifting, awkward postures and twisting movements. Steel strapping machines present a risk of cuts from sudden release of tension. Wrappers present a risk of entrapment in the film rotor.
Evaluación ergonómica carga y descarga: Ergonomic assessment of loading and unloading + inventory of equipment with guards + maintenance records
Evaluación ergonómica de embalaje/desemb: Ergonomic assessment of packing/unpacking: annual + when tasks or products change. Packaging equipment guard check: monthly. Preventive maintenance: per manufacturer (NOM-036-STPS-2018 + NOM-004-STPS-1999)
La manipulación manual de cargas debe ev: Manual handling of loads must be assessed and controlled to prevent musculoskeletal injuries, providing mechanical aids where loads exceed the recommended limits.
¿Se ha realizado una evaluación de riesg: Has a manual handling risk assessment been carried out identifying the highest-risk tasks (heavy, repetitive, awkward posture)? Are mechanical aids provided?
Evaluación de riesgos de manipulación ma: Manual handling risk assessment + inventory of mechanical aids + training records on safe handling techniques
Pesos máximos recomendados para levantam: Maximum recommended weights for individual lifting per NOM -036 STPS
NOM-006-STPS-2014 + NOM-036-STPS-2018 —: NOM-006-STPS-2014 + NOM-036-STPS-2018 — assessment and control of manual handling risks
Evaluación de manipulación manual: anual: Manual handling assessment: annual + when tasks or products change. Training in handling techniques: initial + annual (NOM-036-STPS-2018)
Debe realizarse una evaluación de riesgo: An explosive atmospheres (ATEX) risk assessment must be carried out for the warehouse, considering the likelihood of explosive mixtures forming in any area: lead-acid battery charging, storage of flammables or LP gas.
¿Se ha realizado una evaluación de riesg: Has a risk assessment been carried out under NOM-022-STPS and NOM-001-SEDE for the warehouse's lead (Pb) battery charging areas, flammables storage and LP gas areas? Does the assessment include identification of areas and specific preventive measures?
Evaluación de riesgos en atmósferes expl: Explosive atmospheres risk assessment for the warehouse + methodology used + date of last review + classified zones identified
Las estaciones de carga de baterías de p: Lead-acid battery charging stations generate hydrogen during charging, creating potentially explosive atmospheres in the immediate surroundings. Storage of flammables and the use of LP gas are other sources of explosion risk in warehouses.
Evaluación de riesgos + clasificación d: Risk assessment + area classification + review date
No se almacenan inventarios críticos de:
No critical inventories of flammable substances/materials are stored.
No batteries are stored
LP gas forklifts
Evaluación áreas clasificadas: inicial a: Classified area assessment: initial, before the start of the activity. Review: whenever the substances, processes or warehouse layout change (NOM-005-STPS-1998 + NOM-022-STPS-2015)
Las zonas con riesgo de atmósferas explo: Areas at risk of explosive atmospheres must be classified, documented on an up-to-date plan and marked with the standard explosive atmosphere pictogram at all access points.
¿Se han clasificado y documentado en un: Have they been classified and documented on an up-to-date plan? Are the access points to classified areas marked with the standard explosion pictogram (black triangle on a yellow background with EX)?
Plano de clasificación de áreas+ justifi: Area classification plan + technical justification of the classification + photographs of signage + inventory of controlled ignition sources
In warehouses: battery charging area. Storage of flammable liquids → classify under the applicable NOMs. Classified areas must be reviewed whenever processes, stored substances or the layout change.
Plano de áreas clasificadas + clasificac: Classified area plan + technical classification + photographs of signage at access points
Clasificación de zonas: permanente. Revi: Zone classification: permanent. Review: whenever processes, substances or layout change. Inspection of hazardous (classified) area signage: monthly (NOM-005-STPS-1998 + NOM-022-STPS-2015)
Todo trabajador que acceda a zonas áreas: Every worker who enters hazardous (classified) areas of the warehouse must receive specific training on the risks of explosive atmospheres, preventive measures and the use of anti-static PPE before first entry. Only authorised personnel may enter classified areas.
¿Los trabajadores que acceden a zonas ár: Do workers who enter hazardous (classified) areas (battery charging area, flammables store) have documented specific training? Is there a list of authorised personnel and an explicit prohibition of ignition sources in classified areas?
Registros de capacitación áreas clasific: Classified-area training records signed, with date and content + list of personnel authorised to enter hazardous (classified) areas + signage prohibiting ignition sources at all entrances
La capacitación debe incluir: naturaleza: Training must cover: nature and consequences of explosive atmospheres, prohibited ignition sources (phones not certified for classified areas, spark-producing tools, non-anti-static footwear), required PPE and emergency procedure.
Registros de capacitación áreas clasific: Classified-area training records + list of authorised personnel + ignition prohibition signage
Capacitación áreas clasificadas: inicial: Classified-area training: initial, before first entry to a classified area. Refresher: every 2 years or when substances or procedures change. Update of authorised personnel list: annual (NOM-005-STPS-1998)
Todos los equipos eléctricos y mecánicos: All electrical and mechanical equipment used in hazardous (classified) areas of the warehouse must be certified for use in explosive atmospheres of the category corresponding to the classified zone.
¿Existe un inventario de todos los equip: Is there an inventory of all equipment installed or used in hazardous (classified) areas of the warehouse, with its certification category? Do battery chargers, light fittings and electrical equipment in lead-acid (Pb) battery charging areas have classified-area certification of the correct category?
Inventario de equipos en zonas áreas cla: Inventory of equipment in hazardous (classified) areas with certification category + classified-area certificates of conformity for each item of equipment + photographs of the classified-area marking on the equipment
Los cargadores de batería convencionales: Conventional battery chargers are NOT suitable for use in hazardous (classified) areas — verify their certification before installing them in lead-acid (Pb) battery charging areas.
Inventario de equipos áreas clasificadas: Inventory of classified-area equipment with category + certificates of conformity + photographs of marking
Verificación inicial: antes de instalar: Initial verification: before installing any equipment in a hazardous (classified) area. Inventory review: annual + whenever equipment is installed or replaced in a classified area (NOM-005-STPS-1998)
Los trabajos en altura en el almacén (en: Work at height in the warehouse (mezzanines, access to upper racking levels, racks) must have formalised controls in the risk analysis.
¿Los entrepisos y zonas elevadas están e:
Are mezzanines and elevated areas fitted with guardrails? Are access and work at height controlled by a work permit? Are harnesses inspected before each use?
Are the manlifts certified?
Certificados de manlift\nRegistros de in:
Manlift certificates
Fall protection inspection records + photographs of guardrails + logbook of harness and fall-arrest equipment inspections
No permitir que los trabajadores trepen: Do not allow workers to climb on racking. Provide approved stepladders or elevating work platforms.
NOM-009-STPS-2011 — condiciones de segur: NOM-009-STPS-2011 — safety conditions for work at height in the warehouse
Pendiente certificados de manlift y DC3: Manlift certificates and approved operator DC-3 (training competency certificate) pending
Inspección de barandales: mensual. Inspe: Guardrail inspection: monthly. Harness inspection: by the worker before each use + formal monthly inspection. Annual review of the work at height programme (NOM-009-STPS-2011)
Instalaciones eléctricas — certificacion: Electrical installations — certifications and verification report
Las instalaciones eléctricas del almacén: The warehouse electrical installations must have a verification report (in accordance with NOM-001-SEDE) issued by an accredited Verification Unit before connection to the CFE supply and upon any major modification.
¿El almacén cuenta con un dictamen de ve: Does the warehouse have a current electrical installation verification report issued by an accredited Verification Unit?
Dictamen de verificación eléctrica emiti: Electrical verification report issued by an accredited Verification Unit + report number + electricity supply contract with CFE
dictamen de verificación eléctrica vigen: Current electrical verification report + CFE contract + report reference number
Boletín de verificación eléctrica: trami: Electrical verification certificate: obtain before connection + renew after major modifications to the installation. Electrical inspection by a qualified electrician: annual (NOM-001-SEDE + NOM-029-STPS-2011)
Cualquier modificación, ampliación o rem: Any major modification, extension or refurbishment of the warehouse electrical installation (new circuit, change of distribution board, increase in contracted load) must be carried out by a qualified electrical expert or installer and verified again by an accredited Verification Unit before being put into service.
¿Las modificaciones de la instalación el: Have modifications to the warehouse electrical installation made after the initial verification report been verified again by a Verification Unit? Do extensions or changes of distribution boards have an updated verification report?
Registro de modificaciones eléctricas de: Register of electrical modifications to the warehouse + updated verification report for each major modification + qualified electrical installer / expert who carried out the work
Una modificación eléctrica no verificada: An unverified electrical modification may invalidate the original certificate and introduce serious fire or electric shock risks. CFE may suspend the supply if it detects undeclared modifications. Document all interventions on the warehouse electrical installation.
Registro de modificaciones eléctricas +: Register of electrical modifications + verification reports per modification + electrical installer qualification
Verificación eléctrica: tras cada modifi: Electrical verification: after each major modification (new circuit, distribution board extension, load increase). Internal electrical audit: annual (NOM-001-SEDE + NOM-029-STPS-2011)
Los tableros eléctricos del almacén debe: The warehouse electrical distribution boards must be correctly identified, have up-to-date single-line diagrams, be labelled with the load of each circuit, have access restricted to unauthorised personnel and have a record of interventions. Installed electrical equipment (motors, variable speed drives, UPS) must have NOM or equivalent certification.
¿Los tableros eléctricos del almacén tie: Do the warehouse distribution boards have an up-to-date single-line diagram and circuit labelling? Is access restricted by key or padlock? Does installed electrical equipment (motors, variable speed drives, UPS, light fittings) have NOM certification or a recognised conformity mark?
Diagrama unifilar actualizado por tabler: Up-to-date single-line diagram per distribution board + photographs of circuit labelling + distribution board access and maintenance logbook + NOM certifications for installed electrical equipment
Un diagrama unifilar desactualizado es u: An out-of-date single-line diagram is a serious risk in an electrical emergency: emergency personnel cannot identify the circuits to be disconnected.
Diagrama unifilar por tablero + etiqueta: Single-line diagram per distribution board + circuit labelling + NOM certifications for electrical equipment + distribution board maintenance logbook
Diagrama unifilar: actualizar tras cada: Single-line diagram: update after each electrical modification. Distribution board inspection: monthly (visual) + formal annual. Verification of equipment NOM certifications: at each new installation (NOM-001-SEDE + NOM-029-STPS-2011)
Las instalaciones eléctricas del almacén: The warehouse electrical installations must be designed, installed, maintained and periodically inspected by qualified personnel.
¿Las instalaciones eléctricas del almacé: Are the warehouse electrical installations inspected annually by a qualified electrician? Are distribution boards labelled, marked with electrical hazard signage and access-restricted?
Informe de inspección eléctrica anual +: Annual electrical inspection report + photographs of distribution board labelling + electrical maintenance logbook
En almacenes, prestar especial atención: In warehouses, pay particular attention to: electric forklift charging areas (hydrogen generation), installations in damp or dusty areas, and extension leads with inadequate cable gauge.
NOM-029-STPS-2011 + NOM-001-SEDE — segur: NOM-029-STPS-2011 + NOM-001-SEDE — safety of warehouse electrical installations

Todos los accidentes, incidentes y cuasi: All accidents, incidents and near misses on the EPC project must be reported, investigated and communicated as lessons learned to all site personnel.

El arnés con línea de vida retráctil deb: A harness with a self-retracting lifeline must always be used inside the basket. Never operate an elevating platform in winds above 12.5 m/s (45 km/h). Check the ground bearing capacity before positioning the equipment.

Todas las excavaciones deben contar con: All excavations must have a prior assessment of the ground and hazards, adequate shoring or battering, daily inspection and controlled access.

Todos los trabajos en espacios confinado: All confined space work on the EPC project must be controlled with atmospheric testing, a confined space entry permit, a designated attendant and rescue equipment available.
